note: Column definitions for the daily journal. This file is the single source of truth: the table, the storage, the auto-capture and the docs page all read from it. Renaming a label or adding a field is a data change here, not a code change. `def` is the working definition, `when` is the Eastern-time moment it is recorded, `source` is 'auto' (MT5 can compute it) or 'manual' (your judgement). Codes and modifiers are still being finalised — see the 'To define' list on the docs page.

fields.label: Forced?
fields.def: Did you take a trade you should not have.

fields.label: Reacted?
fields.def: Did you act emotionally rather than from the plan.

fields.label: Homerun?
fields.def: Did a runner reach an outsized target.

fields.label: Stance
fields.def: The strategy set going into the day: what you are trying to accomplish — swing for a home run, preserve capital, go for base hits, manage aggressively. Set once, before the session.

perSymbol.label: Prior Day
perSymbol.def: The type of YESTERDAY's closed daily candle, fixed the moment it closes, classified by PERIOD TREND. Period Trend is set by the previous closed candle: break its HIGH = period UP trend, break its LOW = period DOWN trend. G = a period-trend change (the trend flipped vs the prior period). Y = moved against the period trend but did NOT flip it. B = with the period trend (continuation). R is parked for now — every R is also a G (period-trend change), so it is not yet a distinct category; to be zeroed in later. Modifiers (! ? b c g and compounds like Y.G?) are still to be defined.

perSymbol.label: HTF Break
perSymbol.def: Higher-timeframe level breach. xW = previous week's high or low breached (records on the break day). xMx = previous Mx (options-expiry period) high or low breached - Mx boundaries are first-trading-day -> expiry and expiry -> last-trading-day, per the H1 Thrust Structure Pine; xMx is a later addition once that boundary logic is ported to the EA.

perSymbol.label: Flow Call
perSymbol.def: Your prediction, made when the new daily candle opens, of which way flow will break — NOT the closing direction. u = breaks the high (up), d = breaks the low (down), i = breaks neither (inside), o = breaks both (outside). Multiple letters mean 'unsure, could be either'. Candidate for a machine-learning prediction later; manual for now.

perSymbol.label: Stalk Hit
perSymbol.def: Did price enter either DAILY STALK ZONE today? Zones (off the prior daily candle): prev up-close - upper [H, H+0.25R], lower [L+0.25R, L+0.33R]; prev down-close - upper [L+0.66R, L+0.75R], lower [L-0.25R, L], R = prior range. Latched: records t the moment price touches; stays empty until then.

perSymbol.label: Session Gap
perSymbol.def: At 07:00 ET: is price at least 1 DEVIATION beyond the opening range (the 19:45 ET 15-minute candle)? 1 deviation = the OR's own range (high-low); a gap exists if price >= ORhigh + range or <= ORlow - range. t / f. (Distinct from any inter-session gap concept. INTERPRETATION of '1 deviation' to confirm.)

perSymbol.label: Range Play
perSymbol.def: Your prediction of how the day session (09:30-16:00) will interact with the overnight session's range. i = internal, e = external. ie = trades into the overnight internal range first, then breaks external. ei = external then internal. ii = stays inside the overnight range, never exits. ee = external. eea = from one external side to the other. eeb = launches external and keeps going, never looking back.

perSymbol.label: Midday Call
perSymbol.def: Around noon, given the action so far: your prediction of today's day-type outcome by PERIOD TREND (G / Y / B) — will today flip, fade, or continue the period trend? Same classification as Prior Day, predicted forward. (R parked — see Prior Day.)

perSymbol.label: Result
perSymbol.def: The actual realised day type once today's candle closes (G / Y / B by PERIOD TREND) — the outcome to compare against the Midday Call. (R parked — every R is also a G.) NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is the R column the realised day type, or something else?

auto.note: Fields MT5 can fill without you typing. `from` is a dot-path into the state snapshot; `capHour` is the earliest Eastern-time hour to capture (first-write-wins after that); symbols map to columns via the aliases map. Trend and DR% are wired as a demonstration. The real auto fields (Prior Day, Session Gap, Stalk Hit, HTF Break, Result) become live once the EA emits each — Prior Day and Result also await confirmation of the flow definition.
